about_the_game:
The lifespan in the post apocalypse is short and yours keeps looking shorter and shorter.

Weiss is the Scavenging leader of one of the last bastions of humanity, clinging on to life amidst a forever snowy hellscape teaming with mutated monsters. Everyday life in this wasteland is daunting, but with the sudden disappearance of their partner, Weiss must throw themself face-first into the world they so despise and reckon with what they truly want out of a "future"...

A decade has passed since an otherworldly entity encompassed the Earth, filling the land with cosmic mutations and plunging the world into a never-ending winter night. Humanity has held tightly to life but is still on its last legs against these anomalous humanoid creatures with logic-defying powers at the beck and call of the foreign god. How will you survive?

in this tale you'll find...

  • 50k+ word visual novel set in a post-apocalypse world overrun by anomalous creatures

  • a queer romance between a rough around the edges enby and their calm and collected male partner

  • multiple endings that'll determine if you survive or not

  • a story of prevailing against the odds and humanity persisting by overcoming fear

content_descriptors.notes: This is a post-apocalyptic story set in a fictional fantasy version of Earth. While there is nothing realistically depicted, there are scenes of fighting with can include blood loss, death, and more depending on choices. There is also frequent cursing.
